The disconnect handling of ACL connects in the sample was done

pointer.

Signed-off-by: Emil Gydesen <emil.gydesen@nordicsemi.no>

fixes #38240

issue_context.title: Connected ISO does not disconnect gracefully
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When a connected ISO (CIS) disconnects, it doesn't set the right state, as it depends on the ref to be 1 when unref'fed, which will only happen once the CIG is removed. When a CIS disconnects it then ends up in a state where the controller think it is disconnected, but the host does not, which causes it to be locked in this state, and not even the CIG can be removed. 

**To Reproduce**
N/A

**Expected behavior**
When a CIS disconnects it should go to the DISCONNECTED state and be reconnectable. The CIG shall also be removable since the CIS(es) are in the DISCONNECTED state. 

**Impact**
It is impossible to reconnect a CIS. 

**Logs and console output**
N/A

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: fde0b96bb750e48709bf641b966284514bf77d47


**Additional context**
N/A

review_comments: This sample uses Logging Subsystem, this may be intentional as the sample benchmarks the usecase, but are some essential messages using printk? i.e. if logging subsystem is disabled, are there any requirement to have some necessary messages?

The logging system is used to report errors and information (including statistics). 

`printk` is used for user prompts as this application is interactive. 

This has been raised several times, but I haven't found a way that made it work well with just using one of the two.
